title: Real Ontology Asset Population, Parsing, and Coverage

coverage_gap_root_causes.diagnosis: UMLS shared-CUI crosswalk is incomplete (8.8k ICD9 + 11.3k ICD10 linked); many top-unmapped tokens are Z/V/E/F administrative & history codes (e.g. Z87891, Z20822, V1582, F17210) that legitimately lack SNOMED disease concepts. Normalization verified correct (E78.5, I50.9 map). Improvement: add UMLS MRMAP (SNOMED->ICD map, 148 MB, present in zip) and/or MRREL.
coverage_gap_root_causes.medication: MIMIC medication tokens are formulation/brand/descriptor strings (MED_0_9_SODIUM_CHLORIDE, MED_HYDROMORPHONE_DILAUDID, MED_OXYCODONE_IMMEDIATE_RELEASE) and bare MED_INSULIN, not clean RxNorm ingredient names. Improvement: ingredient-level (IN/PIN) longest-match + concentration/form descriptor stripping.

normalization_hardening: src/preprocessing/code_normalization.py (ICD-9/10 dotting incl V/E codes; drug-name keys) + tests.
next_step: Status B -> improve crosswalk completeness (MRMAP) and medication ingredient matching to lift coverage toward targets BEFORE Phase 1b ontology-backed anomaly-v2.
